input.quote: b) The total liability for either Party, regardless of the form of action, whether contract or tort, is limited to three percent (3%) of the value of the bill of materials contained in the Products delivered to IBM and IBM Customers by MSL in the period beginning with the Effective Date of the Agreement through the resolution of the action.
input.rationale: Section 15.3(b) is mutual, but the cap basis is 3% of the bill-of-materials value of Products delivered — a small fraction of the fees IBM pays MSL and well below the fallback floor of 12 months' fees. There are no carve-outs anywhere in Section 15: MSL's indemnity in 15.1 (infringement, legal non-compliance, warranty failure), the confidentiality obligations in 13.2, gross negligence and willful misconduct all sit inside this cap with no super-cap, which is walk-away territory. The mutual consequential/lost-profits waiver in 15.3(a) is acceptable. The $25,000 limit in the Equipment and Program Loan Agreement Section 15 caps IBM's own exposure and is not flagged. We therefore target the fallback: keep the mutual cap, re-base it on twelve months' fees, and add one carve-out sentence.
